_note: The one escape of the policy checks. Row = { rule, item, ruling, quote }: rule id (chk5-producer ...), the trimmed source line text or path or name the check reports, a dated-note ruling id (MD:YYYY-MM-DD:<line>, M-<n>, D-<n>; never M-246) and the operator's words verbatim. A row allows exactly one violation (ledger.mjs matchLedger). Each row a commit adds needs its ruling id in an Operator-Ruling: trailer of that commit.
